title: Homeopathy Isn’t Harmless – Here’s the Proof
description:
Homeopathy is often advertised as natural, safe, and side-effect free—but new research shows it can seriously harm your liver. A study from the Rajagiri Liver Institute, Kochi, published in Hepatology Communications and indexed in PubMed, reviewed patients with acute hepatitis and liver failure caused by homeopathic medicines

Over three years, nine patients were confirmed with homeopathy-related liver injury, including four deaths. These remedies—prescribed by registered homeopaths—were found to contain 156 compounds, including steroids, narcotics, antibiotics, heavy metals, and high levels of alcohol,

Brands tested included Bakson’s, Similia, Schwabe, HOMCO, Reckeweg, and Adel, all showing contamination or no active ingredients other than alcohol.

This demolishes the myth that homeopathy is harmless. From COVID-19 “prevention” pills like Arsenicum Album 30C, to tinctures contaminated with lead and mercury, homeopathy is not just ineffective—it’s dangerous. If you’ve searched for homeopathy side effects, liver disease from homeopathy, Rajagiri Liver Institute study, Hepatology Communications homeopathy, or homeopathy vs evidence-based medicine, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!
